rules.title: one canonical Capacity V1 resolver exists
rules.requirement: All capacity consumers use one resolver exposing value, source and availability.

rules.title: exact daily capacity has first priority including zero
rules.requirement: An exact daily_capacity row wins. Explicit zero must never fall through.

rules.title: operational universe is the only fallback
rules.requirement: Without exact daily capacity, use operational universe. Settings defaults are forbidden.

rules.title: missing capacity fails closed
rules.requirement: Without exact capacity or usable operational universe, return CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE.

rules.title: legacy 132 capacity assumptions are removed
rules.requirement: No active Capacity V1 path may depend on daily_capacity_default or hardcoded 132 fallback.

rules.title: bed blocks reduce capacity after base resolution
rules.requirement: Effective capacity is resolved base capacity minus inclusive active blocks.

rules.title: forecast and planning propagate provenance
rules.requirement: Forecast and planning expose capacity_source and capacity_available.

rules.title: unavailable capacity never fabricates metrics
rules.requirement: Unavailable capacity must not invent free beds, deficit, percentages or risk.

rules.title: new closures write snapshot provenance V1
rules.requirement: R4 closures persist capacity provenance and operational evidence atomically.

rules.title: legacy snapshots remain unresolved
rules.requirement: Pre-R4 snapshots remain LEGACY_UNRESOLVED with no fabricated history.

rules.title: R2 population and HTTP 504 resilience remain intact
rules.requirement: Canonical population semantics and HTTP 504 resilience must remain unchanged.

rules.title: R4 cutover is auditable and CI enforced
rules.requirement: Runtime markers, tests and CI identify Capacity V1.
